newsitem.title: NICARAGUA: Nicaragua sugar harvest hits all-time record.
newsitem.headline: Nicaragua sugar harvest hits all-time record.

text.p: With its 1996-1997 sugar harvest almost completed, Nicaragua has already achieved a record harvest totaling 7,864,698 100-lb bags to May 25, equivalent to around 357,500 tonnes.
Noel Chamorro, manager of National Commission of Sugar Growers, said the figure was already 16 percent higher than the previous cycle's crop of 6,740,419 quintals (around 306,400 tonnes).

The goal for this cycle is to reach a total of 7,871,662 quintals (around 357,800 tonnes), Chamorro said. The Monterosa mill is the final milling plant still in operation and should be ending milling operations soon.

Production at the San Antonio mill, the oldest in the country, ended on Monday. The mill produced 3.6 million 100-lb bags, its highest level ever, Chamorro said. Last cycle it churned out 2,923,000 bags.
Nicaragua's Victoria de Julio mill also produced a record amount this cycle of 1,311,593 qunitals, Chamorro added.
